content: Dawiti Sa7oolera haasayi giigida mala Yoonataaney Dawites shemppo lagge gidides; bana mala iza siiqides.
He gallassafe doommidi Sa7ooli Dawite banara woththides; izi ba aawa soo bontta mala diggides.
Yoonataaney iza wozinappe siiqida gishshas Dawitera caaqettides.
Yoonataaney ba may7ida kaabbaa kessidi ba ola may7ora, ba giththa mashshaa, ba wondafezanne ba danccoza Dawites immides.
Sa7ooli iza kiittizaso awakka gidiin Dawiti ba kiitettidayssa bessiza mala poliza gishshas ba olanchchata bolla iza shuumides; hessi ubbaa deraanne Sa7oole ola shuumeta ufayssides.
Dawite Bolla Sa7oole Miqqayneteth
Dawiti Filisxeeme addeza wodhidaappe guye asay baso baso simmishin maccassati karabenne maasinqo ekkidi yexxishe, guppishenne ililishe kawo Sa7oole mokkanaas Isra7eele katamatappe kezida.
Maccassati,
Hessi iza ufayssontta aggida gishshas Sa7ooli keehi hanqettides; izikka, «Istti Dawites tammu shii, taas issi shii xalla gida! Histtiin izas kawoteththafe attiin haray aazee attiday!» gides.
Sa7ooli he gallassafe doommidi Dawite iita ayfen xeelo oykkides.

Wonteththa gallas Xoossafe azazettida iita ayanay Sa7oole bolla wodhides; he wode Dawiti kase izi ubba wode ooththizayssa mala bagana shocishin Sa7ooli bason uttidi gooshsha mala haasayshe toora oykki dees.
Izikka, «Dawite godaara gaththa oyseththana» gi qoppidi tooraza iza bolla xongides; Dawiti gidikko nam7uto iza sinththafe sher7i gides.
GODAY izappe shaakettidi Dawitera gidida gishshas Sa7ooli Dawites babbides.
Hessa gishshas Dawite ba achchafe haassidi shaalaqateththan shuumides. Dawitikka ola asaa kaaleththidi istta sinththan kezeessinne gelees.
GODAY izara diza gishshas izi ooththiza miishshi ubbay hanees.
Sa7oolikka Dawites ubba miishshi hanizayssa be7idaappe guye izas babbides.
Kumeththa Isra7eeleynne Yuhuday gidikko Dawite dosida; istta sinththan kezidi, gelidi kaaleththizay iza.
Dawitera Sa7oole Bolloteth

Sa7ooli Dawite, «Neni ola minna olettiko ta naa bayrayo Meroobo ta nees machcho immana» gides; Sa7ooli ba wozinan, «Filisxeeme asay ba kushe iza bolla woththo attiin tani iza bochchike» gi woththides.
Dawiti gidikko Sa7ooles, «Kawo bollo gidanaas ta oonee? Taso asay gidiin ta aawa keeththi Isra7eele asaa achchan aazee?» gides.
Gido attiin Sa7oole naa Merooba Dawite gelana wodey gakkishin Maholaate dere as Adir7eeles imettadus.
He wode Sa7oole naa Milkoola Dawite dosadus; Sa7oolikka hessa siyidi ufayettides.

Sa7ooli ba wozinara, «Izas woximade gidana mala, izi Filisxeemeta kushen aadhdhi imettidi dhayana mala ta izo izas immana» gi qoppides. Hessa gishshas Sa7ooli Dawite, «Hekko neni tanara bollotanaas qasseka qaada demmadasa» gides.
Hessafe guye Sa7ooli ba shuumetas, «Dawites, ‹Hekko kawozi nenan ufayettides; iza shuumetikka nena doseettes; hessa gishshas ne izas bollo gida› giidi izas xuurite» gi azazides.
Istti hessaka Dawites zaari zaari yootida; Dawiti gidikko, «Kawora bolloteth intte laafa miishsha mala qoodidetii? Tani keeha manqonne asa matan daro erettontta asa» gides.
Sa7oole shuumeti Dawiti gidayssa izas yootiin,

Sa7ooli, «Dawite, ‹Kawoza nayi gishshas neeppe ciloosha koyzay ba morkketa bolla halo kessanaas Filisxeeme asaappe xeetu asaa attumateth qanxxa ehada immanayssafe attiin hara koyenna› giidi yootite» gides. Sa7ooli hessa qoppiday Dawiti biidi Filisxeemeta kushen kundana mala koyza gishshassa.
Kawoza shuumeti hessa Dawites yootiin kawora bolloteththi iza ufayssides. Hessa gishshas barida barey aadhdhontta dishin,

Dawitinne izara diza asati biidi Filisxeeme asaappe nam7u xeet wodhida; kawozas bollo gidanaas qanxxi ehida attumateththaa istta qooda mala kawozas immides; hessafe guye Sa7ooli ba naa Milkoolo Dawites immides.
Sa7ooli GODAY Dawitera dizayssanne iza naa Milkoola Dawite siiqidayssa eridi,
Sa7ooli kaseppe aaththi babbides; hayqqanaashe gakkanaas izas morkke gidides.
Filisxeeme ola gadawati kase keziza mala olas kezeettes; Dawiti attida Sa7oole ola gadawatappe bollara xoono demmides; hessa gishshas iza sunththi keehi erettides.
